cases.text: Hi parents, please make sure Maya's swimmers and a towel are packed for the carnival on Friday 20 November.
The electricity account is overdue. Please pay $243.10 by 16/11/2026 to avoid a late fee.
Your car registration will expire on 3 January 2027. Renew online before then.
Could you let us know by Thursday whether Leo will attend the excursion?
Are you free to catch up on Wednesday afternoon? Let me know what works.
Don't forget the P&C meeting minutes need to be reviewed before the next meeting on 24 November.
Sign-up for the school disco closes at 5pm on 12 November. Add your child's name using the form.
Your dental check-up is booked for 2 December at 9:15am. Please arrive 10 minutes early and bring your health card.
We haven't received your enrolment form yet. Please send it in as soon as you can.
Please reply with your preferred time slot for the parent-teacher interview.
FYI the school oval might be waterlogged on Monday so sports may be moved indoors.
Heads up: the swimming program may start a week later than planned. We'll confirm soon.
Applications for the school captain leadership program are open to eligible Year 6 students. See the website for details.
Sports uniforms are available at a discount this month for families who qualify.
We've lodged your claim and will contact you when the assessor has reviewed it.
Still waiting on the plumber to confirm availability for next week.
Your visa application is being processed. No action is needed from you at this time.
Thanks for your enquiry. A team member will be in touch within five business days.
Your RSVP for the end-of-year concert has been recorded. See you there!
Thanks, got the signed form.
Your refund of $50 for the cancelled excursion has been issued.
Your booking for the 10:30 session is confirmed.
Apologies, the meeting has been moved to Thursday at 2pm.
Training on Tuesday is off because of the wet weather. Back to normal next week.
Due date extended: the form is now due on 30 November.
Room change: Parent-teacher interviews will now be held in the library.
Congratulations to all our Year 12 graduates!
Our newsletter this week features a profile of our new librarian.
Here are the photos from last week's excursion. Enjoy!
Thank you for your feedback. We appreciate you taking the time to write.
Please find attached the minutes from last week's meeting for your records.
Sarah has arranged the cake for Friday, so no need to worry about it.
